prior_summary: A learned action DDPM conditioned on a causal recurrent encoder with an ordered three-mode latent event state: approach_open, close_contact, and lift_carry. The latent mode gates the denoiser through trainable embeddings and is supervised by demonstration-derived phase and transition losses.
applicable_conditions: Use when the red block is the upper block in the initial stack, the gripper/TCP and block poses are observable, and the required behavior follows open approach, finger closure/contact, lift, and early carry toward the red goal. The policy can also start during the shared lift-to-carry overlap when fingers are already closed and red is elevated.
termination_guidance: Transfer or stop this skill when the fingers remain closed, red has lifted clearly above blue, and the TCP/red pair has begun lateral motion toward the red goal; in the demonstrations this corresponds to red z around 0.13 to 0.30 m and the end of the expanded slice near index 190.
limitations: The event labels are inferred from poses, finger aperture, and demonstration futures, not measured contact. The implementation has no inverse kinematics, no image encoder, and no hard geometric constraint; failures such as empty grasps or red not moving with the TCP must be handled by policy selection or recovery outside this model.

config.phase_label_rule: approach if finger width is open and red is not lifted; close_contact if finger width is below 0.055 m before lift; lift_carry if red z exceeds 0.095 m, red-blue z separation exceeds 0.070 m, or labeled future red z exceeds 0.135 m with closed fingers
config.causal_forward_inputs: raw_history only: qpos, qvel, tcp_pose, red_pose, blue_pose, drawer compatibility channels, red_goal, blue_goal
config.auxiliary_training_inputs: future_obs and future_mask are used only to form phase/transition labels in compute_loss
